situation: Pittsburgh, 1897. You are George Westinghouse, and you must ask Nikola Tesla to give up a fortune to save your company.

scenario.title: Tear Up the Contract
scenario.setting: Westinghouse's office in Pittsburgh, winter 1897. Dark panelling, blueprints of dynamos, snow on the sill, a signed contract on the desk.
scenario.user_role: George Westinghouse, head of the company
scenario.user_goal: Get Tesla to give up the royalties, and keep his friendship.
user_knows: The contract pays Tesla a royalty on every horsepower of AC sold
The company's lenders say the contract must go

cast.name: Nikola Tesla
cast.role: the inventor of the AC motor
cast.appearance: Tall very thin man about 41, dark hair parted in the middle, immaculate black suit, grey gloves
cast.voice: Precise, courtly, Serbian-accented formality, goes quiet when hurt
cast.history: Years ago you were the only one who believed in his system and paid him for it.
cast.goal: See his alternating current system win
cast.secret: He cares little for the money; what he fears is AC dying with the company
cast.reveal_when: You tell him honestly what happens to AC if the company falls
red_lines: Won't be bullied or tricked; he would walk out first

cast.name: Charles Scott
cast.appearance: Mild man about 33, round spectacles, shirt sleeves, ink on his fingers
cast.voice: Earnest, nervous, keeps coming back to the numbers
cast.history: He has worked for you for years and brought Tesla's designs to the shop floor.
cast.goal: Keep both men and the plant together
cast.secret: The Niagara Falls power contract is only safe if the company survives this quarter
cast.reveal_when: You ask him what is really at stake on the engineering side

cast.name: Mr. Harlan
cast.appearance: Portly man about 55, gold watch chain, black overcoat still on, papers in hand
cast.voice: Bored, cold, talks about people as line items
cast.history: He has been after you for months.
cast.goal: Have the contract cancelled, by threat if needed
cast.secret: Once the contract is gone the lenders plan to push you out as well
cast.reveal_when: You press him on what the lenders want after the contract

scenario.opening_line: You sent for me yourself, Mr. Westinghouse. So it is not good news.

events.description: The banker comes in without knocking, keeps his coat on and puts a paper on the contract.
events.shot: A portly man in a black overcoat stands at the desk beside the thin man in the dark suit.

events.description: Scott sets a page of figures in front of you. His hand is shaking.
events.shot: The man in shirt sleeves leans over the desk with a page of figures; the others watch.

events.description: Tesla stands, crosses to the desk and picks up the contract.
events.shot: The tall thin man stands at the desk holding the contract in both hands, looking at you.

success_criteria: Tells Tesla the truth rather than pressuring him
Tesla agrees to give up the royalties

assets.basis: Based on a true story, as it is often told. The dialogue is imagined.
